title: Robust and Learned Online Matching in Growing Trees
abstract: arXiv:2609.40077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study irrevocable maximum-cardinality matching in trees revealed by successive leaf attachments, with a known horizon and an exogenous growth law that is misspecified or unknown. For deterministic affine attachment forecasts with nonnegative degree reinforcement, the optimal threshold policy loses at most twice the cumulative expected conditional total-variation error relative to an online oracle knowing the actual growth law. This follows from a unit-span property of the Bellman continuation score and has no additional horizon factor. A four-vertex example attains the coefficient two for the specified deterministic policy, and a two-model argument gives a lower bound linear in the model-error budget for arbitrary policies under general misspecification. translated_title: 生长树中的鲁棒与可学习在线匹配
translated_abstract: 我们研究通过连续叶节点附着逐步揭示的树上的不可撤销最大基数匹配问题，其中时间范围已知，但外生增长律可能被错误设定或未知。对于具有非负度数强化效应的确定性仿射附着预测，最优阈值策略相对于知晓实际增长律的在线预言机，其损失至多为累积期望条件全变差误差的两倍。这一结论源于Bellman延续值的单位跨度性质，且不含额外的时间范围因子。一个四顶点例子表明，在指定的确定性策略下系数2可以达到；同时，双模型论证给出了一般错误设定下任意策略关于模型误差预算的线性下界。对于均匀-优先附着模型，局部误差可通过叶节点计数得到精确表达式。当其常数混合参数未知时，我们从同一生长过程中对其进行估计。
tldr: 该论文研究了增长律被错误设定或未知时生长树上的不可撤销最大基数在线匹配问题，证明了最优阈值策略的损失至多为累积期望条件全变差误差的两倍，且该界与时间范围无关，并给出了相应的紧下界和未知参数的在线估计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper studies irrevocable maximum-cardinality online matching in trees under misspecified or unknown growth laws, proving that the optimal threshold policy loses at most twice the cumulative expected conditional total-variation error with no horizon factor, along with matching lower bounds and online estimation of unknown parameters.
